findings.problem: The rule that a batch of fewer than 20 texts is not begun can permanently strand a small backlog. For example, if the final unembedded theme has six texts, even a longer window still produces a batch of six, so its vectors are never made. This contradicts the goal of working off the backlog across windows.
findings.suggestion: Apply the minimum only when insufficient time limits the batch. Allow a smaller batch when it contains all remaining eligible texts, and test a final backlog below 20 texts. Align the corresponding spec passage.

summary: One remaining batching rule can permanently leave the final themes without vectors.
